title: US Debt-to-GDP Ratio — Live vs 2024 Official 122.9%
excerpt: Live US debt-to-GDP uses today's Treasury debt divided by current GDP. The 2024 official year-end ratio was 122.9%. Track the live chart, historical data, and how the US compares to other countries.

The current U.S. national debt is $39.97 Trillion as of August 22, 2026, according to the latest data from the U.S. Treasury Department. This US debt live counter equals approximately $119,299 per U.S. citizen. The debt increases by roughly $1 trillion every 750 days and grows at approximately $1.3 billion per day, making this national debt clock live view a real-time snapshot of America's borrowing. Source: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data.

How this clock is calculated

The official total comes from the U.S. Treasury's Debt to the Penny dataset. Between Treasury records, the display projects the latest observed daily change and labels estimated values. Latest source date: 2026-03-19.
